newsitem.title: JAPAN: General Motors to sell new Corvette in Japan.
newsitem.headline: General Motors to sell new Corvette in Japan.

text.p: General Motors Corp (GM) said on Tuesday it would start selling its 1997 Chevrolet Corvette in Japan in early May.
The new Corvette is the fifth generation of the classic Detroit muscle sports car and the first redesign since the 1984 model year vehicle.
It was unveiled in the United State earlier this month.
GM's Japanese unit has yet to decide on the Japanese price or set any sales goals.
In the United States, the manufacturer's suggested retail price for the car starts at $38,060.
GM will display the Corvette at an import car show put on by the Japan Automobile Importers' Association for three days from Friday.
Also on display at the show will be the new Mercedes-Benz SLK230 KOMPRESSOR, a two-seater sports car.
Mercedes-Benz Japan Co Ltd, the Japanese unit of Mercedes-Benz AG, said on Tuesday it would start selling the SLK230 in Japan from early February.
A spokesman for Mercedes-Benz, the automobile unit of Daimler-Benz AG, said prices would start from 4.9 million yen ($42,200), with the company aiming to sell 2,000 of the cars this year.
In December, the association said it expects about 450,000 imported vehicles to be sold in Japan 1997, up from a record 427,525 last year.
The motor show in Tokyo will feature about 230 imported cars from nine countries. Organisers expect 230,000 people to visit the show.
